name: MOSS-Image SFT ComfyUI
readme:
# MOSS-Image SFT ComfyUI

PRIVATE / REPLACEMENT VALIDATION PENDING: this pin is the first candidate. Its queue presets and optional second-LoRA variant passed, but browser testing found a gateway Host/Origin mismatch. A corrected replacement image and version 0.1.0 promotion are pending; replace this digest and validate before public release.

Use one NVIDIA GPU with at least 24 GB VRAM on a CUDA 13.0-compatible host. Set your own MOSS_PASSWORD of at least 12 characters before starting; login user is moss and there is no default password. Prefer a Runpod Secret. Open HTTP port 8188 for preparation progress and the protected ComfyUI UI.

First startup downloads and verifies 23.51 GB of public model files and is not instant. Keep the 60 GB volume mounted at /workspace to retain models and your work. MOSS_VOLUME_GB=60 matches that provisioned volume size; update it if you resize the volume. Open /?template=photography-bf16&source=moss for the photography graph. Port 22 uses your Runpod SSH key.

The corrected gateway derives the standard Runpod public origin automatically. For a custom domain set MOSS_PUBLIC_ORIGIN to its exact HTTP(S) origin, with a nondefault port if needed and no path. This behavior still requires replacement-image browser validation.

This template remains private until corrected-image browser, GPU, and restart checks pass.
